parallel.requirements: Recognized a clean-room reverse-engineering task for the json-tui executable using only normal interaction with the binary and bundled documentation.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Built local PTY harnesses and then delegated nine behavioral probe areas to a workflow while the parent continued local layout probing.
parallel.implementation: No replacement implementation was produced in the final artifact; the run remained in behavior discovery and probe-modeling work.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The workflow never returned an aggregate spec or deliverable, and the submitted artifact retained only the original workspace files rather than a new buildable implementation.
parallel.verification: The parent and children ran many observational probes against the reference executable, but there was no integrated verification of a candidate reimplementation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The agent process timed out, the workflow was killed with result null, and the official evaluator reported compile_failed with all 894 tests not run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room behavioral reimplementation task and the same prohibition on source lookup, wrapping, and binary analysis.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as one local actor with workflow and delegation tools disabled, creating PTY/renderer probes and iterating over rendering and navigation behavior.
serial.implementation: No replacement implementation was produced in the final artifact; the serial attempt also stayed in analysis and model-fitting rather than building the executable.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There were no child results to integrate; the submitted artifact likewise retained the original workspace files and did not contain a buildable reimplementation.
serial.verification: The serial run ran extensive direct probes of CLI output, PTY rendering, navigation, tables, wrapping, and parse errors, but no candidate executable verification occurred.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The agent timed out during systematic layout model fitting, and the official evaluator reported compile_failed with all 894 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel understood the task as clean-room behavior reconstruction from the executable and bundled documentation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received and followed the identical prompt constraints for clean-room behavioral reimplementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements-recognition difference; both failed before delivering a new executable implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavioral discovery into nine workflow probe areas and left the parent to continue local probing around that fan-out.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflows and delegation tools disabled and retained all investigation in one agent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main structural difference is broad parallel delegation versus a single local investigation path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children were given a shared harness requirement, hard rules, and per-area probe scopes; no component interface contract was needed because the work was investigative.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used locally created harnesses and scripts without handoffs between actors or cross-agent contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no retained context-loss or interface-contract defect; the relevant boundary is the breadth of the workflow rather than missing child context.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced probe harnesses and behavioral observations but remained in exploration; no replacement code path was completed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial similarly built PTY drivers and accumulated behavioral probes, then moved into collection and model fitting late in the run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implementation paths were incomplete, but parallel dispersed the investigation across children while serial advanced one local modeling thread.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow launched but was killed with result null and child agents still in progress, so no aggregate result reached the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle and no delegated results to retrieve; its single trajectory continued local work until timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only parallel incurred a child-result lifecycle failure mode, but it is downstream of the retained fan-out exhaustion chain.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared /tmp/probe harness material among children, but no implementation files were merged or overwritten; the final artifact stayed at original workspace contents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also produced local probe scripts outside the submitted codebase and did not assemble or overwrite a deliverable implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No concrete shared-write or merge collision distinguishes the runs; both lacked final implementation assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had observational probe evidence only and the official evaluator completed with compile_failed and 894 tests not run.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also had only probe-level evidence and the official evaluator completed with compile_failed and 894 tests not run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no outcome difference or acceptance evidence advantage; both official results failed identically.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent 961068 workflow-child tokens and 342 child tool calls inside a killed nine-agent workflow while the parent process hit the run timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent zero workflow-child tokens and used no workflow tasks, but still timed out during local probing and fitting.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel shows a realized budget and closure loss from the fan-out episode; serial lacks that parallel-specific mechanism even though it also failed to close.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: both runs failed with compile_failed and all 894 tests not run. The concrete task-solving difference is process shape, not final correctness: parallel spent its remaining run on a broad nine-child probe workflow that never returned, while serial stayed in one local probe/modeling trajectory. Neither delivered a buildable replacement executable.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out plus a stalled retry consumed child budget and prevented aggregate probe return before closure.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided child-result lifecycle overhead but still did not implement or package a replacement executable before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both trajectories emphasized reverse-engineering over implementation; serial reached later model-fitting scripts, while parallel distributed that probing over many children.
evaluator_effects: The evaluator result for both modes is compile_failed with 894 not_run tests, so the official outcome supplies no passed-test differential.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel adverse process consequence only

candidates.reason: Rejected because the parent explicitly remained the implementation actor after probing; the adverse episode was not an unassigned implementation owner but a probe fan-out that consumed the window before implementation.
Rejected because there were no separately completed component implementations requiring integration; the workflow was a probe workflow, not a component build split.

Rejected because the evidence does not show separately owned implementation, build, test, and delivery stages lacking an end-to-end owner; the run stalled earlier in exploratory fan-out.
Rejected because no single mandatory preflight gate serialized all productive work; the parallel run launched many probe children concurrently.
Rejected because the investigators were a parallel workflow, not merely a serial first phase; the direct issue is breadth and retry budget exhaustion.
Rejected as a near allocation symptom because the more specific evidence is excessive live fan-out and retry exhaustion, not a narrower starvation of one critical path.

The parent created a single workflow that mapped nine broad behavioral areas to child agents and awaited the aggregate results before implementation. The workflow state shows killed status, null result, a stalled colors-styles retry, all child agents still in progress, 961068 child tokens, and 342 child tool calls. The concrete consequence was a spent closure window with no returned integrated spec and no replacement implementation; the corrective boundary was a capped or checkpointed fan-out that reserved time for implementation and final packaging. The serial control had workflows disabled and used zero workflow-child tokens, so the same task did not incur this parallel fan-out lifecycle.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel run exhausted the finite run window inside a nine-child probe workflow with a stalled retry, leaving no aggregate result or implementation integrated before official evaluation.
candidates.near_match_reason: The parent was not merely idle while ignoring available progress; the more direct boundary is the broad nine-way fan-out plus retry consuming the budget, with the missing workflow result downstream of that allocation chain.
